BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: BE   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: BIOTECHNOLOGY   SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT : BT6023 PLANT & AGRICULTURE BIOTECHNOLOGY

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) Define the term Cellular totipotecy. [2]
 (b) Write the applications of plant tissue culture. [3]


Q2 (a) How will you sterilize the seeds needed for explantation for plant tissue culture work? [2]
 (b) List out various plant growth regulators and their names? Discuss the role of auxins and
cytokinins in plant tissue culture media.
[3]


Q3 (a) What is somaclonal variation? Is it advantageous or not for culture conditions? [2]
 (b) What are synthetic seeds?   How are they formed? Mention two of its advantages. [3]


Q4 (a) Differentiate between organogenesis and embryogenesis.

[2]
 (b) What are the limitations of anther culture?  Mention the uses of production of haploids. [3]


Q5 (a) What are   plant secondary metabolites? Give two examples. Mention their uses. [2]
 (b) What is biotransformation? Discuss by giving two examples. [3]


Q6 (a) What is ex situ and in situ conservation? [2]
 (b) What is cryopreservation? Discuss the methods of cryopreservation of plant cultures. [3]

Q1 (a) Describe the advantages and limitations of in vitro culture. [2]
 (b) Write about various organic nutrients used in in vitro culture media. [3]


Q2 (a) Describe the importance of various gelling agents used in in vitro culture. [2]
 (b) What is the role of various plant growth regulators used in in vitro culture?  [3]


Q3 (a) Write about callus culture and its applications. [2]
 (b) Describe about artificial seeds and its potential uses. [3]


Q4 (a) Describe about the importance of somaclonal variation. [2]
 (b) Write about the various stages of micro propagation and their importance. [3]


Q5 (a) Explain about the different types of suspension cultures. [2]
 (b) How measurement of growth is performed in suspension cell cultures? Describe. [3]


Q6 (a) Describe about the patterns of growth curve in suspension culture. [2]
 (b) Justify the role of bioreactors in the production of secondary metabolites. [3]
